summary: Conspiracy: Abyss Universe is a quick drafting card game where players build a pyramid of colored, numbered cards trying to complete key-matching or numeric sets before opponents. It plays fast and light, serving as a small-box spinoff of the Abyss universe rather than a full strategy game.
criticised: fairly light and forgettable for gamers seeking depth
luck of the draw can outweigh planning
overshadowed by the deeper Abyss base game

interaction.kind: drafting from a shared, shrinking pool of cards grouped by color
interaction.detail: Every card you take or leave behind changes what's available (and what color groups accumulate) for the next player, so drafting choices are made partly to deny others useful colors or numbers. There's no attacking or board conflict, but the shared draft pool means your pick directly shapes opponents' options each turn.
interaction.said: unknown — a light filler card game with little written specifically about its interaction level

subsystems: single pyramid-building/drafting engine (one reverse pyramid per player) that generates all scoring
sources: Card value totals in your pyramid
scoring.how_you_win: Draft cards each turn to fill out your reverse pyramid (5-4-3-2-1 rows); as soon as one player completes their pyramid, the game stops and everyone scores their best card per color, their biggest same-color chain, location-card bonuses, and the pearl/key majority bonus — highest total wins.
